description: Ministry of Industries - The Society know as the Christian Society of Jehovah's Witnesses in Sri Lanka Situated No. 711 Station Road, Wattala
categorisation: This gazette notification exercises powers under the Societies Ordinance (Chapter 123) to authorize a specific purpose for a society and exempt it from certain provisions of the Ordinance. This constitutes a regulatory action under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
